apis.name: fwupgrade_hal_set_download_url
apis.brief: Sets the URL and filename for a firmware download. This function configures the URL from which the firmware image will be downloaded and the local filename to store it.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., null pointers, failure to open configuration file). @note  Refer to relevant documentation or guidelines for specific filename format requirements and any additional error scenarios.

apis.name: fwupgrade_hal_get_download_url
apis.brief: Retrieves the firmware download URL and filename. This function populates the provided buffers with the URL and filename of the firmware to be downloaded, as retrieved from the configuration.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., null pointers, configuration errors). @note See relevant documentation for details on the expected filename format and potential error conditions.

apis.name: fwupgrade_hal_set_download_interface
apis.brief: Configures the network interface for firmware downloads. This function sets the network interface used for downloading firmware updates over HTTP. - 0: wan0 - 1: erouter0
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., invalid interface value, configuration file error).

apis.name: fwupgrade_hal_get_download_interface
apis.brief: Retrieves the configured firmware download interface. This function fetches the network interface identifier used for firmware downloads. - 0: wan0 - 1: erouter0
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., null pointer, configuration file error).

apis.name: fwupgrade_hal_download
apis.brief: Initiates firmware download and installation. This function fetches the firmware image from the configured URL, validates it, and performs the installation process.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On successful download and installation of the firmware. RETURN_ERR - On general failure (see potential causes below). 400 - Invalid URL or failure to resolve the hostname. **Potential Causes of RETURN_ERR:** - Failure to retrieve the HTTP download URL or filename. - Error downloading the image to the CPE. - Failure executing the OEM-specific firmware flasher. - Error setting the boot state to the new image.

apis.name: fwupgrade_hal_get_download_status
apis.return_doc: The firmware download status: 0 - Download not started. 1-99 - Percentage of download completed. 100 - Download complete, pending reboot. 400 - Invalid HTTP server URL. 401 - Cannot connect to HTTP server. 402 - File not found on HTTP server. 403 - HW Type DL Protection Failure. 404 - HW Mask DL Protection Failure. 405 - DL Rev Protection Failure. 406 - DL Header Protection Failure. 407 - DL CVC Failure. 500 - General Download Failure.

apis.name: fwupgrade_hal_reboot_ready
apis.brief: Retrieves the reboot readiness status. This function checks if the system is ready to be rebooted after a firmware update. - 1: Ready for reboot. - 2: Not ready for reboot.
apis.return_doc: Status of the operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., null pointer).

apis.name: fwupgrade_hal_download_reboot_now
apis.brief: Triggers an immediate reboot to apply downloaded firmware.
apis.return_doc: Status of the reboot operation: RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - If another reboot is already in progress or an error occurred.

apis.name: fwupgrade_hal_update_and_factoryreset
apis.brief: Performs a firmware update and factory reset on the device. This function initiates a firmware update process and, upon successful completion, performs a factory reset to restore the device to its default settings.
apis.return_doc: Status of the update and reset operation. RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., download error, reboot in progress).

apis.name: fwupgrade_hal_download_install
apis.brief: Downloads and installs a firmware update from the specified URL. This function fetches the firmware image from the provided URL and initiates the installation process.
apis.return_doc: Status of the firmware download and upgrade operation. RETURN_OK - On success. RETURN_ERR - On failure (e.g., server unreachable, invalid URL, download or installation error).
